rationale: The pain of comparing self-hosted LLM inference costs against API pricing is real and commercially relevant for ML engineers, but evidence remains thin: a single HN comment provides the seed signal, adjacent tools (Infracost, CloudZero) confirm the cost-visibility category but don't prove willingness to pay specifically for LLM inference comparison. The market moves too fast—model pricing changes weekly—making any calculator stale quickly, and the five-distinct-pain-quote threshold is not met from available sources.
